{
  "dataset_name": "pricerunner",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "category_id_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Min-max normalized category_id using training set min=2612 and max=2623, producing a smooth continuous score across the category range",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "numeric_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth linear projection of category_id useful for SVM margin separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(category_id - 2612.0) / (2623.0 - 2612.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vendor_id_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized vendor_id to compress the wide range (1-368) into a smoother distribution suitable for linear models",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "numeric_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skew in vendor_id distribution, improving linear separability for vendor-correlated product categories",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(vendor_id)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_id_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized cluster_id to compress the wide range (1-47525) into a smoother distribution",
      "value_range": [0.0, 11.0],
      "feature_family": "numeric_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skew in cluster_id, helping linear SVM find meaningful boundaries related to product clustering",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(cluster_id)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_id_deviation_from_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of cluster_id from training mean (30112.7), normalized by training std (18413.4), measuring how far a product cluster is from the average",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "statistical_deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures outlier cluster positions that may correlate with specific product categories, useful for SVM margin definition",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(cluster_id - 30112.717280453257) / 18413.43815251668"
    },
    {
      "name": "vendor_id_deviation_from_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of vendor_id from training mean (120.7), normalized by training std (117.3), measuring vendor position relative to average",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.5],
      "feature_family": "statistical_deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures vendor outliers that may specialize in specific product categories, aiding linear separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(vendor_id - 120.71624173748819) / 117.26204817442233"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_vendor_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of log-normalized cluster_id to log-normalized vendor_id, capturing relative scale between product cluster and vendor identifiers",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite ratio feature that may capture product-vendor relationships useful for linear SVM boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(cluster_id) / np.maximum(np.log1p(vendor_id), 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_length_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Character length of product_title normalized by log transformation, capturing title verbosity as a continuous feature",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "text_statistics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Product title length correlates with category specificity; technical products like CPUs tend to have longer titles than simple appliances",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(product_title.str.len())"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_word_count_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Number of words in product_title normalized by log transformation, capturing description complexity",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "text_statistics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Word count in titles differs systematically across product categories; mobile phones and CPUs tend to have more technical descriptors",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(product_title.str.split().str.len())"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_has_numeric_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator whether product_title contains numeric characters (digits), indicating technical specifications in the title",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "text_statistics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Technical products like CPUs and cameras often include numeric specs in titles, helping linear SVM distinguish technical from appliance categories",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(product_title.str.contains(r'\\d', regex=True, na=False), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_label_length_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Character length of cluster_label normalized by log transformation, capturing model name complexity",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "text_statistics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cluster label length reflects product naming conventions that differ by category; brand-model combinations vary systematically",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(cluster_label.astype(str).str.len())"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_appliance_keyword_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score (0-1) reflecting how strongly the product_title contains keywords associated with large home appliances (e.g., fridge, freezer, washing, dishwasher, microwave) versus electronics or computing terms. Score near 1 indicates strong appliance signal, near 0 indicates electronics/computing signal.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth continuous signal distinguishing appliance categories from electronics categories, directly useful for linear SVM margin separation across the two broad product groups",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "title_technical_specificity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score (0-1) reflecting the technical specificity of the product_title, where 1 indicates highly specific technical terminology (model numbers, GHz, MP, processor specs) and 0 indicates generic or simple descriptive language. Captures the density of technical identifiers.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_judgment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Technical specificity varies strongly across product categories; CPUs and cameras have highly specific titles while generic appliances do not, providing a smooth continuous feature for linear SVM boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
